subject: SOC 2 recert: retention carve-out & audit evidence cadence
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recert: retention carve-out & audit evidence cadence

Hi Ana —

Thanks again for taking time last week. As Acme's renewal approaches we want to lock down the SOC 2 recert path so your procurement and security teams have everything they need. Two asks from our side to keep things moving:

1) Retention carve-out request: Acme mentioned needing a 13+ month access window for some forensic logs. We do a standard 12-month audit log retention for hosted customers; extending to 18 months is possible via a term amendment but we need to confirm scope and legal language. Attached is a draft retention table (retention-table.pdf) that maps retention tiers to potential amendment language.

2) Evidence cadence & capacity: For the evidence handoff we propose a staggered upload over 10 business days to avoid large bursts. If you prefer a single bulk handoff (one week) we can provision temporary burst capacity — estimate attached (audit-window-capacity-estimate.xlsx).

I've attached an evidence index export (soc2-evidence-index.csv) with current artifacts we plan to surface. Can you confirm: (a) whether Acme will accept a rolling handoff, or (b) needs a single bulk delivery and an 18-month retention amendment? If (b) we'll include the wording in the contract addendum and coordinate DocuSign.

Next steps: if procurement wants the term language, loop them in and we can produce redline within 48 hours.

Cheers,

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Renewals | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: soc2-evidence-index.csv (CSV), retention-table.pdf (PDF), audit-window-capacity-estimate.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@acme.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert: retention carve-out & audit evidence cadence

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the clear note. Acme's InfoSec will want the 18-month retention for specific event logs related to payments and auth failures. Procurement is copied — they will need the amendment language before legal will sign.

Two clarifications from our side:
- The rolling handoff is preferred if it doesn't change the evidence fidelity. If anything is missing in the earlier batch we need to be able to request a supplement.
- If you do an 18-month amendment we will need a one-time credit for the extra storage/retention cost and a short escalation contact for any future audit questions.

Procurement: can you confirm required PO/contact details so we can align timing?

Best,
Ana Ruiz
Security Operations Manager | Acme Corp.
ana.ruiz@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0133

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert: retention carve-out & audit evidence cadence

Laura / Neha —

Looping in a quick technical/controls read on the asks. Short answers:

- 18-month retention for a subset of logs is viable, but it needs an explicit scope (which log streams, retention format, and whether logs remain searchable). We can support cold retention (compressed, retrieval within 48-72 hours) to lower cost.

- Evidence fidelity: rolling handoff is fine. We'll stamp each upload with a manifest and versioned checksums so Acme can validate integrity and request supplements if something is missing. That satisfies most auditor requirements for continuity.

- Credits: we can offer a one-time credit to offset the incremental storage for the remainder of the renewal term (pro-rated). finance will need the estimated storage delta — see audit-window-capacity-estimate.xlsx for ballpark.

Action items I can own:
1) Draft the technical appendix language (scope + retrieval SLA + manifest format) — I'll have the first draft by Thu EOD (2026-06-24).
2) Coordinate with infra to reserve burst capacity if Acme wants single bulk delivery — estimate in the attached workbook.
3) Provide manifest template and checksum process for Acme's auditors.

Privacy/Security note: we must avoid exporting any KMS-protected encryption keys in the evidence bundle; we will export logs in encrypted-at-rest form with retrieval access controls.

Karthik Iyer
Principal, Applied Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert: retention carve-out & audit evidence cadence

Hi all —

Thanks — quick summary and proposed next steps so we can close the renewal and the upsell request for audit window support.

What we agreed (tentative):
- Scope: 18-month cold retention for Payment and Auth Failure event logs only (as defined in the technical appendix).
- Delivery: Rolling handoff over 7 business days with a manifest and checksums; Acme may request up to two supplemental uploads within 14 days of final handoff.
- Commercials: Redwood will apply a one-time pro-rated storage credit for the additional retention for the 12-month renewal term. If Acme wants the retention to extend beyond the renewal term we'll add a permanent pricing tier (we can discuss at renewal).
- Capacity/upsell: for the single bulk delivery option Acme accepted the temporary burst capacity estimate; we will provision a reserved burst window and bill as a one-time line item. This is a chance to demonstrate capacity vs. future committed Dedicated capacity (if you want predictable throughput we can include Dedicated options in the renewal quote).

Next steps:
1) Karthik to share technical appendix draft (Thu 2026-06-24) — delivered.
2) Laura to send contract redline with the retention appendix and one-time credit terms for Legal/Procurement review — target Tue 2026-06-29. DocuSign link will be provided.
3) Neha to coordinate finance/PO details with Acme Procurement.

Ana / Procurement — please confirm acceptance of the above so we can slot the DocuSign and reserve the burst window. If you prefer an immediate single-bulk handoff instead of the rolling plan, tell us today and we'll flip to the bulk delivery path.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Renewals | Redwood Inference
